Time for an upgrade.

Liz’s car had crossed the 100,000-mile mark, and she was ready for something new. She came to Done Deal Auto Group to help make the switch.

A trade-in offer matched.

We matched the trade-in value another dealership offered for her car and helped her lease a brand-new Acura MDX. From an older car with plenty of miles to a fresh start in a new Acura, we made the switch easy.

Congratulations, Liz! Thanks for trusting Done Deal Auto Group with your next chapter.
